paragraphs: The S-Type 2.7d uses the AJD‑V6 — a 2.7‑litre V6 diesel engine sourced from PSA, fitted to the X200‑generation S‑Type from 2004 to 2008. It was offered alongside petrol V6 and V8 options in the S‑Type range, providing a more economical diesel alternative. The S‑Type 2.7d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. Jaguar S-Type 2.7d Engine Compatibility The S-Type 2.7d uses a single engine family (AJD‑V6) across its entire production run. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code via registration or VIN - Your generation (X200) and year - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build We always start with your registration rather than a generic S‑Type quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. Jaguar S-Type 2.7d Applications by Generation The Jaguar S‑Type 2.7d was fitted with the AJD‑V6 2.7‑litre diesel V6 across the X200 generation from 2004 to 2008. How much does a Jaguar S-Type 2.7d engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,900. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my S-Type 2.7d? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your engine code (it should be AJD‑V6) before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild AJD‑V6 S-Type 2.7d engines? Yes. We rebuild the AJD‑V6 diesel to original specification with updated components. Do you supply used S-Type 2.7d engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my S-Type 2.7d if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does an S-Type 2.7d engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most S-Type 2.7d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12‑month unlimited‑mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the S-Type 2.7d from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
